identityPolicy: A release benchmark, conformance report, or corpus-derived baseline must attach the per-file SHA-256 inventory emitted by scripts/build-pdf-corpus-governance.py --hash-files. Acquisition identity alone is not sufficient for a reproducible result.
privateDataPolicy: Private, client, or locally sourced documents must never be uploaded, copied into public fixtures, or used by an external reference tool. They may be locally inventoried only after the operator confirms their authorization.
untrustedInputPolicy: Every corpus file is untrusted input. Reference tools run as local subprocesses with time and resource limits; a malformed-file result is evidence, not permission to relax a security assertion.
duplicatePolicy: Before accepting a new corpus or baseline, run scripts/analyze-pdf-corpus-duplicates.py over its SHA-256 inventory. Exact duplicates must be recorded; near-duplicates need an explicit rationale before they can enlarge a coverage denominator.

stabilityContracts.rule: A corpus change may not silently add a skip. Any changed allowlist entry requires its owning issue and an explicit expiry or review rationale.
Changing fixture membership, page count, or floor requires a reviewed baseline update with the corpus SHA-256 inventory.

A performance fixture or budget change requires a new local result with host, tool version, and corpus SHA-256 inventory.
